description: This file defines the StringUtils class with static methods for string manipulation, including camel case conversion and translation lookup, within the SuiteCRM utility namespace.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string operations such as camelCase to snake_case conversion, translation, and camel case splitting.

methods.name: camelToUnderscoreCase
methods.description: Converts a camelCase string to snake_case, optionally uppercase.

methods.name: camelToTranslation
methods.description: Attempts to translate a camel-cased string into a label, or formats it into a human-readable string if no translation is found.

methods.name: explodeCamelCase
methods.description: Splits a camelCase string into its component words.
